title: Evaluation Module Overview
summary: This module provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating AI agent and function performance, encompassing online evaluation, dataset generation, diverse evaluator types, and robust reporting and telemetry.

nodes.label: Core Evaluation Engine
nodes.title: Core Evaluation Module
nodes.description: Provides the foundational components for online evaluation, including configuration, dataset generation, and the mechanisms to run and dispatch evaluators for functions and agents.

nodes.label: Evaluator Definitions
nodes.title: Evaluator Types Module
nodes.description: Defines the base classes and concrete implementations for various evaluators, categorizing them into case-level and report-level analysis. It provides tools for assessing individual task outputs and generating aggregate reports.

nodes.label: Reporting & Telemetry
nodes.title: Reporting & Telemetry Module
nodes.description: Provides utilities for collecting OpenTelemetry spans for tracing and functions for rendering numerical differences and durations in evaluation reports. It supports detailed comparison and formatting of performance metrics.

groups.label: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.title: Core Evaluation Orchestration
groups.description: Manages the overall evaluation lifecycle, including configuration, dataset generation, and dispatching evaluators for functions and agents.

groups.label: Evaluator Definitions
groups.title: Evaluation Logic & Types
groups.description: Defines the various types of evaluators, from case-level checks to aggregate report generators, providing the 'how' of evaluation.

groups.label: Reporting & Observability
groups.title: Reporting & Telemetry
groups.description: Focuses on collecting, formatting, and presenting evaluation results and performance metrics, including OpenTelemetry integration for tracing.
